description: Read your workspace's payout schedule: whether it is on, weekly or monthly, its run day, whether it retries transfers on its own, the next run day, the period that day will request and what the last run day did. schedule is null when none is saved. Payout schedules are part of payout runs: while those are not switched on for your workspace, execution.enabled is false and schedule is null. Needs a Last Price credential with billing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: get_payout_schedule
